title: Destination City
summary: Given the array paths, where each element paths[i] = [cityAi, cityBi] represents a direct path from cityAi to cityBi, identify the destination city that has no outgoing paths.
statement: Given the array paths, where each element paths[i] = [cityAi, cityBi] represents a direct path from cityAi to cityBi, identify the destination city that has no outgoing paths. The graph formed by these paths is guaranteed to be a linear path without any loops, ensuring there is exactly one destination city.
constraints: The directed paths form one chain with exactly one terminal city.
Return the city that never appears as an origin.
hints: Collect every path origin in a set.
Scan destinations for the one absent from that set.
The chain guarantee makes that city unique.
Every nonterminal city has an outgoing edge and therefore appears among origins.
editorial: Every nonterminal city has an outgoing edge and therefore appears among origins.

tests.explanation: Sao Paulo is the only destination never used as an origin.
Following D to B to C ends at A.
